digest.component_or_area: configuration schema and cross-ticket duplicate detection
propositions: verify.overlap_enabled config key is undocumented in docs/config.md despite being read by enrich_drain.py and plan_review/__init__.py
The name overlap_enabled obscures what the feature produces (advisory link suggestions) and its cost model (scales with store size), causing operator confusion
verify.overlap_enabled must be renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets with permanent aliases to preserve existing TOML configs and environment variables
Both TOML key alias (via _ALIASES) and environment variable alias (via _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES) must be maintained with permanent deprecation registry entries
docs/config.md must add a new inventory entry documenting suggest_duplicate_tickets, its three-stage workflow, advisory nature, and tuning parameters
